requirements.statement: FS0 SHALL distinguish repository content, desired GitHub operating state, observed GitHub state, authorized mutation, and verified resulting state.
Canonical bootstrap source roles SHALL keep FS0 realization input semantically distinct from successor Design Proposal input.
Governance, Conformance, and Assurance SHALL be the only authority-bearing keystones delegated by the Framework Contract.
No FS0 authority record SHALL acquire keystone authority implicitly.
Every accepted normative requirement SHALL have a stable machine-resolvable identity.
A missing bootstrap prerequisite SHALL stop bootstrap with a clear error before mutation.
GitHub mechanisms SHALL remain subordinate realizations and SHALL NOT define Governance, Conformance, or Assurance semantics.
Generated repository-orientation and license surfaces SHALL be deterministic for identical canonical inputs except explicitly declared variable installation-state fields.
Repository-orientation surfaces SHALL NOT become independent semantic owners.
Substantive bootstrap implementation SHALL be machine-resolvably distinct from the canonical bootstrap invocation surface.
Every bootstrap-installed successor Design Proposal seed SHALL have authority state none.
Each generated successor Design Proposal Markdown surface SHALL be a deterministic projection of its canonical structured proposal read representation.
Generated proposal Markdown SHALL NOT become an independent semantic owner.
Post-cutover FS0 SHALL require no semantic, template, generator, or script input from an external bootstrap environment.
The repository root SHALL be the complete structural governance boundary; no filesystem namespace beneath it SHALL remain outside structural governance.
Authority lifecycle_state SHALL support accepted, superseded, and withdrawn.
Requirement conformance_applicability SHALL be mechanical or none.
Requirement assurance_applicability SHALL be required or none.
Bootstrap state SHALL be candidate or cutover.
After cutover, the bootstrap cutover record SHALL be immutable except through later accepted authority that explicitly governs recovery or reconstruction.
